checked.comment: Adversarial MAB with losses in [0,1]. The algorithm needs T and K. Recording T >= K as unmapped is consistent with the source.
Self-bounding Condition (1), no uniqueness assumption. D is noted as unmapped.
Adversarial DEE-MAB. The decoupled feedback is correctly described in unmapped. The algorithm only needs K.
Matches Theorem 1: G log T + sqrt(C G log T) + K^2/sqrt(log T) + K log T + D.
Matches Theorem 2: G log^2 T + sqrt(C G log^2 T) + K^2 log^{3/2} T + D.
Matches the beta != 1/2 branch of Theorem 3.
Matches the beta = 1/2 branch of Theorem 3, where the constant 4 is absorbed.
Matches the stochastic bound of Theorem 3, with W_tsa expanded correctly.
Matches Theorem 4: O(sqrt(KT)). The learning rate K^{1/6} sqrt(t) makes it anytime.
Matches the stochastic bound of Theorem 4. The sum over V maps correctly to sum_subopt.

summary: The extraction matches the paper closely. All four main theorems are recorded, with the adversarial and stochastic bounds as separate results. Theorem 3 is split by beta regime, and the expressions, constants, tuning and settings all agree with the source. I found no errors that need correcting, and no performance theorem is missing. The intermediate lemmas and Theorem 29 are correctly left out.
